responsibility: Contains the primary RTL machine description for TILEPro: UNSPEC codes, operand includes, instruction and expander patterns, assembly output templates, attributes, TLS and PIC sequences, stack-protector operations, network and special-register instructions, and other target-specific lowering rules. It is the declarative instruction-selection layer that maps GCC RTL onto TILEPro instruction encodings and cooperates with predicates, constraints, and the scheduler model to produce legal and scheduled machine code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the C source/header pair and the option definition file, this is the RTL machine-description source for TILEPro, written with define_insn/define_expand/define_constants forms and included predicate/constraint descriptions. It distinguishes itself by declaring instruction selection, expansion, and assembly templates for target operations, rather than C macros/hooks or option metadata.
